description: You are the VP of Operations at Northbridge, a professional services firm. Your executive team has decided to establish a standing weekly operational review to ensure cross-functional alignment across finance, sales, and engineering. In the Odoo Calendar (http://localhost:8069, login: admin/admin), create a new recurring weekly meeting titled 'Operations Weekly Review'. The attendees should be senior leadership at Northbridge—look them up in the Contacts to identify the right people. Set the meeting to recur every week, and configure an email reminder so attendees receive advance notice before each meeting. Save the event when done.
